sourceDeltaPolicy: Union of run-bound manifest paths is compared only where the corresponding archived source copy is manifest-covered and SHA-verified. A missing counterpart is unverified; no absence or equality of its original checkout file is inferred. Only the lock pin difference is expected automatically. Product-source deltas and unverified counterparts need manual equal-feature review.
interpretation: Descriptive per-process samples and paired medians only. No causal attribution or blanket performance acceptance is inferred. Scan CPU deltas subtract each kind-specific before sample and include sequential redraws, with closed also including teardown. Five-sample p95 equals the maximum and is below general percentile quality guidance. SurfaceCounters is explicitly unavailable (E_NOTIMPL); logical target bytes/cache/render/resize are never GPU allocation or peak memory.
